sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: These Terms of Service ("Terms") are an agreement between you and Conklin Official LLC ("we", "us"), which operates the BravoBall app (the "App"). By creating an account or using the App, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
sections.content:
You must be at least 13 years old to create an account on your own. A child under 13 may use the App only with a parent or guardian's verifiable consent, given through the process described in our Privacy Policy. Until the parent or guardian approves, the child can use the App only on that device, with limited features. A parent or guardian can revoke consent at any time, which deletes the child's account.

If you are under 18 (or the age of majority where you live), you may use the App only with the permission of a parent or legal guardian, and your parent or guardian agrees to these Terms on your behalf and is responsible for your use of the App.

sections.title: 3. Your Account
sections.content: You are responsible for keeping your login details private and for activity on your account. Do not share your account or use someone else's.

sections.title: 4. Community Rules
5. Coaches and Teams
sections.content: Coaches may add to their team only players who have agreed to join, and may use the training information they see only to coach those players. Coaches must not use the App to collect players' personal information or to contact players outside their team role. A coach can see the training activity of players on their team only. If a coach deletes their account, their team is removed and its players are simply taken off the team; the players' accounts and training history are not affected.

sections.title: 6. Your Content
sections.content: You keep ownership of your training data, custom drills, and other content you add. You give us a non-exclusive license to store and use it only to run and improve the App for you.

sections.title: 7. Prohibited Conduct
sections.content: You agree not to: (a) use the App for any unlawful purpose; (b) try to gain unauthorized access to any part of the App or other users' accounts; (c) interfere with or disrupt the App or its servers; (d) upload viruses or malicious code; or (e) scrape, copy, or resell the App or its content.

sections.title: 9. Deleting Your Account
sections.content: You can stop using the App at any time and delete your account in the App under Profile > Manage Account > Delete Account. Deletion is permanent; see the Privacy Policy for what is deleted. You can also ask us to delete your account by emailing team@conklinofficial.com.

sections.title: 10. Suspension and Termination by Us
sections.content: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these Terms or puts other users at risk. Where reasonable, we will tell you why.

sections.title: 11. Purchases and Refunds
sections.content: If the App offers in-app purchases or subscriptions, they are sold through the Apple App Store or Google Play, renew as described at purchase, and can be cancelled in your store account settings. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their refund processes.

sections.title: 12. Training Safety
sections.content: Soccer training involves physical activity and risk of injury. You agree to: (a) check with a healthcare professional before starting a training program if you have any health concerns; (b) use proper equipment and a safe space; (c) stop training if you feel pain or discomfort; and (d) be responsible for your own safety. Players under 18 should train with appropriate adult supervision.
